filter.requires: known discovery date, latitude/longitude, MTBS ID

candidate_frame.selection: All rows in the saved annual FPA-FOD screen for the allowed train/validation years; crosswalk matching is not used to construct this frame.

crosswalk_gate.join_rule: Discovery date window -1/+2 days; one unique FEDS event; at least one perimeter within 3 km during the first 24 hours from FEDS t_st; two consecutive 12-hour states.

limitations: FPA-FOD discovery point is an incident reference, not a verified GPS ignition coordinate.
Reported final area and MTBS ID are reference-only and must not enter simulator observations, rewards, scenario matching, or policy selection.
The candidate frame is screened to >=5000 reported acres in ten western states and is not a representative national sample.
FEDS records only large-event perimeters above 4 km2; crosswalk eligibility conditions the benchmark on satellite-detectable early fire growth.
This manifest contains train and validation candidates only; no 2024 test records were read or copied.

source.license_note: USFS RDS says FPA-FOD may be used without additional permissions or fees; cite the RDS edition. Joined products have separate terms.
source.name: USFS Fire Program Analysis Fire-Occurrence Database (FPA-FOD)
